tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student intern at a marketing firm, and you need to provide feedback to your fellow intern, Alex, on a market research presentation he gave recently. While the presentation was generally good, there are a few areas that could be improved. Write an email to Alex.
bullets: Commend him by mentioning specific aspects of the presentation that were effective.
Describe the areas that were not as successful.
Suggest ways to enhance future presentations.
tasks.subject: Feedback on Recent Presentation
